scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @semp/api & npm run dev --workspace @semp/web & npm run dev --prefix landing-page-v2
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @semp/shared && npm run build --workspace @semp/api && npm run build --workspace @semp/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @semp/notifications && npm run test --workspace @semp/api && npm run test --workspace @semp/web
scripts.build:site: npm run build --workspace @semp/web && npm run build --prefix landing-page-v2 && node tools/assemble-site.mjs
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U semp -d semp
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx tsx --env-file=../../infra/local-db/local.env scripts/bootstrap-catalog.ts && npx tsx --env-file=../../infra/local-db/local.env scripts/seed-local-admin.ts
scripts.dev:api:local: cd apps/api && npx tsx watch --env-file=../../infra/local-db/local.env src/main.ts
